notes.title: Dev Diary #7 - Making the combat system fun and full of action
notes.notes:
🎥 Dev Diary Episode 7 is now available!

[previewyoutube=PJQ5K;full][/previewyoutube]

A new update on the develpment of our new action platformer coming to you directly from the developers.
🎬 Watch it now!
In this episode, an introduction to a new member of the team, plus, what has been the focus of this past few weeks for us: [b]refining the combat system[/b] to make it [b]fast-paced[/b], [b]super fun[/b] and [b]full of cool moves[/b]. We added new enemies with new abilities for hurting Nanuka and a flying enemy as well. Furthermore, now you have barriers that will prevent the player from moving on if they don't defeat all the enemies on the screen.

Also in this episode, an inside look at how we've reworked the feature art of the game, to make it more in line with what Nanuka really is.

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Starting Level Design
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is the second episode of our monthly devlogs following the development of our new cinematic puzzle platformer Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon.

In this episode we share insights on how we are tackling the design of further levels in the game. As level 1 and 2 aim to familiarise the player with the controls and the story, from level 3 onwards we start developing new mechanics and exciting combat encounters.

In this episode we also share our project management system, which we refined while working on our previous game, Full Void.

We also added a couple of bloopers at the end. Just to remind everyone we are developers, not professional Youtubers :)

We hope you enjoy the episode and we'd love to hear your feedback. Please leave your comments and we'll make sure to reply!

[previewyoutube=zkrNFqk3Ak0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you liked the video, please consider to subscribe to our channel to support us and to be notified whenever a new episode is out. Also, if you have questions you would like to ask the developers, please write them in the comments, and we will answer them in a future devlog.

And don't forget to wishlist Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon on Steam!

Thank you and until next time!
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Behind the Scenes of 'Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon'
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is our first announcement ever for Nanuka's Steam page, and we are excited to share that we have just released the first episode of Nanuka Developer Diary!

In this video, we share more details about the development process and the idea behind this colorful 2D cinematic puzzle platformer. You will hear from Ali (lead developer) along with Leo and Tom (pixel artists and animators) as they explore inspirations, discuss artistic choices, and talk through the prototype phase that led us to the final concept.

[previewyoutube=LLVvVhqehiY;full][/previewyoutube]

This is the first in a series of monthly devlogs that we are releasing on YouTube. We hope you enjoy the video and subscribe to our channel to be notified whenever a new episode is out. Also, if you have questions you would like to ask the developers, please write them in the comments, and we will answer them in a future devlog.

And don't forget to wishlist to support our indie studio!

Thank you and all our best wishes!
The OutOfTheBit Team
